summary_1line: Stories highlight Brahmin power: Kasyapa revives Earth, Utathya forces Varuna to return his abducted wife, and Agastya burns fleeing Danavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Utathya in fury drinks up the world's waters until the oceanbed and hundreds of lakes lie dry before the despairing Varuna.
The blazing sage Agastya stands like a living sun while Danavas burn and fall from the sky under the fire of his ascetic energy.
Varuna’s underwater palace gleams with countless lakes and apsaras as he keeps the abducted Bhadra within its radiant halls.
